set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KYSSZRDP783ZZ20EC7CK28M4. PRD phase PH1A and requirement SPT-004. Implement the frozen spatial4s-core contract in the sibling spatial4s repository with JVM and Scala.js identity laws. Publish or pin an immutable revision that mesh4s-geometry resolves directly. Documentation must distinguish spatial4s.Frame, a coordinate frame, from the unrelated frame4s typed dataframe library. image4s re-exports and reframe4s migration are non-blocking follow-ups, not mesh4s 0.1 gates.
set.title: PH1A: implement and publish spatial4s-core
